New INTRODUCTION Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC) of NCISM, Govt. of India, New Delhi conducts Online Counseling for allotment of All India Quota (AIQ) Seats of Under Graduate (BAMS/BSMS/BUMS/BHMS/B.Pharm-ITRA) and Post Graduate (MD/MS) courses under Govt./Govt. Aided colleges (15%), Deemed Universities (100%), Central Universities/National Institutes of Ayurveda/ Siddha/ Unani/ Homoeopathy medical streams, and Institutional Quota PG seats of Banaras Hindu University. Install “ Sandes “ to get counselling related messages.
